iteration.timing: After material update, old_grad/old_direction assignment, history append; before iterations increment and coefficient convergence check

stage.timing: After stage physical validation, before frequency-map transfer

material.writeback: Only returned m/inner are accepted. No PR reset channel; modifying J/Q in place leaves A inconsistent.
material.G19: R13:140-146 installs original full_material_readout; observer private bind overrides prepare/readout

audit.schedule: R13 iteration: increment progress; ordinary physical periodic audit first; caller_iteration(row) second; budget check last
audit.purpose: Already-paid physical candidates, not current-state setter
audit.overrun: Audit checks budget after physical state before dispatch; charge solve but exclude overdue candidate

minimal_seams.candidate_only_period: Use existing caller_iteration and private R13 function clone; maintain own global period counter. Reuse DenseFieldCurrentProjectors on X=J/scale and Q. Q is absent per-step: R15-only payload extension Q.copy() avoids an unrecorded dense re-evaluation. Original callback return cannot update PR. Emit paid physical candidates via original audit/record path under pre/post budget checks.
minimal_seams.trajectory_injection: Requires explicit R15-only consumed-state/restart seam in fork of R8 loop; no such API currently exists. Specify m/A/J/Q writeback, old_grad/old_direction reset, stopping delta semantics and frequency-family compatibility. Reprojecting DR current into JD+range(U) is a separate paid operation/algorithm choice for parent, not an existing automatic callback effect.
minimal_seams.basis_factory: Reuse R10 prepare_twofold/_prepare and original LowRankDenominator/readout. Existing twofold=.1 strong S vectors plus orthogonalized strong G residual with absolute residual cutoff1e-10; variable rank, NOT fixed19. Parent must freeze spectral rank/cutoff choices for R15. Current basis and material denominator basis are different objects.

DR.source: R12 DenseFieldCurrentProjectors, portable exact copy verified
DR.state: X=J/scale,Q; material shadow cm is real[cells]; full iterator X/Q is needed, shadow alone not replay state
DR.projectors: material(X,Q)->cx,cq,cm; affine_ball(X,Q)->ax,aq; original DR uses affine_ball(2cx-X,2cq-Q), then X+=omega*(ax-cx),Q+=omega*(aq-cq)
DR.scaling: scale defaults6, material alpha=m/scale, port T=scale*S before mask/whitening

setup: H_cholesky:1 (background SPD, not physical Maxwell LU)
H_setup_rhs:sum receivers over unique whitened/masked port maps
costs.qualification: Separate background/aux counters from model.cost physical LU/RHS; do not double-add role counters or setup delta

DR.API_limit: run_projection reinitializes from physical audit of initial_material; does NOT accept a supplied arbitrary X/Q iterator, clocks exclude separately measured projector setup. For periodic continuation use projector methods and inherited update order; parent chooses DR state persistence/reset policy.
DR.grouping: R14 C2 passes grouped_ports=True; R12 defaultFalse. Both keep one global data-ball multiplier; do not silently change chosen path.

budget_selection.absolute_clock: time.process_time() including imports/setup; deadline=cap*.6 then deadline=cap for original corrector; no phase clock restart
budget_selection.candidate_record: m,j,Q,Y_prediction plus candidate,CPU,phase,Phi=D+R,D,R,residual/delta,legal,eligible,deadline,physical counters; best=minPhi legal eligible; secondary=min(R,Phi) among CN99-feasible legal eligible
budget_selection.raw: best after proposal, including initial; primary=global best; corrected=best corrector or previous best; secondary absent has downstream deployment primary fallback
budget_selection.prefix: 15/30/60/90/120 min eligible Phi among already completed candidates; export CANDIDATES.npz:m matches HISTORY indices
budget_selection.DR_shadow_audit: C2:249-251 physically audits cm from material projection before reflected DR update, not an automatically recomputed shadow at the new iterator
budget_selection.receipt: whole_process_CPU_seconds/physical_cost/projector_cost/auxiliary_receipt; external Windows GetProcessTimes separately authoritative whole child; nested clocks/counters not summed
budget_selection.exceptions: BudgetEnd inherits BaseException, exits loops after finally receipts; no automatic full-state serialization/restart

open_parent_decisions: Spectral selection/rank policy for R15 twofold (existing threshold-based union is not fixed19).
Periodic trigger definition, number of DR steps, omega, persistent versus reset reflected X/Q, and whether outputs are candidates only or feed the PR state.
If feeding current, representation projection and explicit PR reset/stage/termination semantics.
Budget scope and paid audit cadence; preserve all actual costs/failed/overrun steps and original physical selection.
